validation_gaps: Validate combined draft vocabulary/head, GDN state publication and attention changes with the same weights, seed, sampling policy, C1/C8, 2K/long-context inputs and tuning settings. Component gains cannot establish <=10ms or unchanged acceptance. The historical14.8ms and ninfer11.5ms figures are not new measurements. Keep reduced-vocabulary and numerical changes unpromoted until paired output/acceptance and quality gates pass.
closure_authorization: Owner requested qualified merges and consolidation of related unqualified work into a few drafts, retaining all source and records before closing superseded entries.
source_retention: Publication commit parents/ancestors retain every exact original head and full source tree; original branches are not deleted. Patches and complete discussion snapshots are also retained here.
